```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(facspseudocolor)
source(system.file("quarto", "_report-setup.R", package = "facspseudocolor"), local = TRUE)
analysis <- facs_report_input(params$config, params$analysis_rds)
bundle <- build_facs_figure_bundle(analysis, facs_report_appearance(params),
                                   params$appearance_file, seed = 1)
facs_report_save_artifacts(analysis, bundle, params$output_analysis_rds,
                           params$output_figure_bundle_rds, params$overwrite)
```

## Pseudocolor panels

```{r}

```
